subject: im
question: What are the two most important costs in EPQ?
title: Setup Falls, Holding Climbs
hook: Bigger batches cut one cost and grow another.
answer: EPQ (Economic Production Quantity) = the batch size to make in one production run at minimum total cost.
Cost 1, setup cost: paid once per run (tool changes, settings, labour, trial pieces); setup cost per year falls as batch size rises.
Cost 2, holding cost: paid on stored stock (space, insurance, capital tied up, damage); rises as batch size rises.
Total cost = setup + holding (U-shaped curve); it is lowest where setup cost = holding cost, and that batch size is the EPQ.
